hacker_news.title: A Schema Named Hash Sent Our Ruby SDK into Infinite Recursion
hacker_news.author: khalidkhair
hacker_news.summary: Schemas named after standard-library types broke our generated SDKs in TypeScript, Rust, Kotlin, Python and Go, and exposed a naming problem that reserved-keyword lists couldn't solve.

linked_context.page_title: A Schema Named Hash Sent Our Ruby SDK Into Infinite Recursion
linked_context.page_description: Schemas named after standard-library types broke our generated SDKs in TypeScript, Rust, Kotlin, Python and Go, and exposed a naming problem that reserved-keyword lists couldn't solve.
linked_context.page_excerpt:
Schemas named after standard-library types broke our generated SDKs in TypeScript, Rust, Kotlin, Python and Go, and exposed a naming problem that reserved-keyword lists couldn't solve.

We generate SDKs from OpenAPI documents in ten languages. When an API defines a schema, the generator produces a model with the same name. A schema named User becomes a User class. A schema named Invoice becomes an Invoice class.

Those names belong to the API's author, who picks them without knowing which languages they'll end up in. For years we treated that as a solved problem. Every language publishes its reserved keywords, so we kept a table for each one and renamed anything that appeared in it. A property named class or a schema named void got escaped, and every other name passed through untouched.

source_briefs.item_name: Claude Code is accidentally exposing secrets all over GitHub
source_briefs.content_summary: 安全研究人员发现，Claude Code因其设置文件处理方式存在疏漏，导致数千个敏感信息（如数据库密码、API密钥、root登录凭证）通过GitHub上的公共仓库泄露。问题源于用户选择“是，且不再询问”以批准运行命令时，该命令本身有时会被写入本地的“.claude/settings.local.json”文件，该文件可能被意外提交到公共代码库。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 这暴露了AI编码工具在安全实践上的重大隐患，提醒开发者在集成此类工具时需严格审查自动生成的配置文件，并避免将包含敏感信息的本地设置提交到版本控制系统。

source_briefs.item_name: Show HN: Broken links silently waste your Google crawl budget
source_briefs.content_summary: 文章指出，网站上的失效链接（404错误）会无声地消耗谷歌爬虫的抓取预算，损害SEO权威。谷歌爬虫遇到404错误时，虽然不会立即惩罚网站，但会通过浪费抓取资源、损害用户体验信号和潜在影响内部链接权重三种方式对网站产生负面影响。文章还探讨了开发者如何自动化审计流程。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 这是一个常被忽视的技术SEO问题。自动化定期检查并修复失效链接，对于维持网站健康度和搜索引擎可见性至关重要，是网站运维的必备实践。
